description:
Cut video and audio by editing the words people say. Rescript turns speech into a private, on-device transcript, so removing a sentence from the transcript removes the matching moment from your media.

EDIT WORDS. SHAPE THE CUT.

Import a video or audio file and let Rescript transcribe it on your device. Read through the conversation, remove the words you do not want, and preview a tighter cut without hunting through a traditional timeline.

BUILT FOR SPOKEN MEDIA

• Edit video by deleting words from a transcript
• Transcribe speech privately on your device
• Keep source media and transcript data local
• Identify and label speakers
• Remove filler words and unwanted sections
• Split scenes, delete clips, and trim clip edges
• Fine-tune word timing when you need precision
• Undo and redo edits freely
• Edit audio, podcasts, interviews, tutorials, and talking-head video
• Preview your finished cut before export

FREE TO EDIT

Download Rescript and use the complete editing workflow for free. When you are ready to export, unlock unlimited video and audio exports with a one-time $9.99 in-app purchase. There is no subscription. Restore your purchase on another eligible device with the same Apple ID.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your media is copied into private app storage and processed locally. Rescript does not upload your video, audio, or transcript to a cloud editing service. On-device transcription models can be downloaded for offline use.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF VIDEO EDITOR

Rescript is made for creators who think in sentences instead of timecodes. Use it as a transcript-led video trimmer or audio cutter for interviews, podcasts, explainers, lessons, voice recordings, reels, shorts, and any project where the spoken story drives the edit.
promotionalText: Turn spoken words into clean cuts. Edit video and audio from a private, on-device transcript, then unlock unlimited exports with one purchase.
